gen-gf-numans-fs-karma: Karma reads classic, with quiet modulation under Numans here. Karma can drop a size, a trustworthy classic serif with little cap gap under that wide-set sans.
gen-gf-onest-fs-erode: Single-thread heading over a modest serif marks Onest with Erode on the sheet. Erode's gentle ebb of weight against that matching-thickness sans is the real hook.
gen-gf-onest-fs-karma: A generous x-height with c terminals hanging far from the bowl marks Onest over Karma below. Karma's quiet modulation against that monoline is the real spark.
gen-gf-open-sans-fs-erode: Erode holds a broad aperture on the g and a under Open Sans on the sheet. Erode meets those distinct c gaps on a text serif line.
gen-gf-orienta-fs-karma: Chisel-notch openings over a quiet serif mark Orienta with Karma on the sheet. Karma's modest weight shift against that contemporary sans is the real hook here.
gen-gf-ovo-archivo: Archivo reads editorial, with curves opening outward under Ovo on the sheet. And Archivo holds a commanding x-height, a plain sans under that dignified serif o.
gen-gf-ovo-fs-asap: Wide-mouthed serif over open-arc letters: Ovo with Asap here. Asap can drop a size, a readable sans with a body height nearly matching the caps below.
gen-gf-ovo-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans holds wide s curves and zero thick-thin under Ovo. Fira Sans's skimming line against that slight thick-thin is the real spark in the sans-serif.
gen-gf-ovo-fs-public-sans: Dignified is Ovo, a rounded o nearly matching the capital over Public Sans. And Public Sans's hefty lowercase against that stone-carved heft is the real hook.
gen-gf-ovo-general-sans: General Sans reads clean, with steady pen pressure under Ovo. And General Sans likes a notch down, a sans with an unobstructed path around each bend.
gen-gf-ovo-manrope: Literary is Ovo, a rounded o nearly matching the capital o. Manrope's single-width pen against that comfortable thick-thin is what stands out in the sans here.
gen-gf-ovo-montserrat: Ovo keeps a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links. Montserrat glides like copper pipe under that literary serif, a geometric sans with oversized counters.
gen-gf-ovo-satoshi: Sturdy hairlines over a laser-cut line: Ovo with Satoshi. Satoshi cuts every stroke level with a wide-open e, so copy stays approachable through many lines of sans-serif.
gen-gf-ovo-switzer: Swiss is Switzer under Ovo, with c tips that stay apart. And Switzer holds a pencil-line consistency under that soft thick-thin, an approachable sans on the sheet.
gen-gf-ovo-work-sans: Work Sans holds open c tips and matching joins under Ovo across the whole sheet here. The running copy stays modern through many lines of sans-serif.
